lines.text: Previously. Sieg held the old stone bridge against Morvudd, and counted to sixteen.
lines.tts: Previously. Seeg held the old stone bridge against Morvudd, and counted to sixteen.

lines.text: Mr. Sable stepped between two seconds and told me. He opened the crossing. He took Haruki first, as bait.
lines.tts: Mr. Sable stepped between two seconds and told me. He opened the crossing. He took Hah-roo-kee first, as bait.

lines.text: Haruki put his hand on my shoulder. The door stayed shut. We killed a Calamity.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee put his hand on my shoulder. The door stayed shut. We killed a Calamity.

lines.text: And under the cathedral, forty people sleep in crystal with their Brands scraped out.
Three hundred years in the ice, Tyr. Sealed by the same people who sealed the red one.
Wake up. There is a city of gold to the south. And the Saint would like to keep it.
Praise the Saint! The Order saved the plains!
Morvudd is dead! The Saint's light killed it!
People of Lumen. The Calamity Morvudd is slain. The golden wall held, as it always will.
The Rite continues. Every light you lend keeps the wall bright.
The Order saved the plains. The Order never left the walls.
He said the Saint's light killed Morvudd. Takuto killed Morvudd. With Haruki. And Sieg. And a wolf.
lines.tts: He said the Saint's light killed Morvudd. Tah-koo-toh killed Morvudd. With Hah-roo-kee. And Seeg. And a wolf.

lines.text: Nobody ever cheers for the wolf.
He is asking them to lend more light. After the bridge. After everything. He is asking for more.
Why more?
I do not know. But I am going to ask him. Tonight. To his face.
It is cold.
It is midsummer, Nemu.
lines.tts: It is midsummer, Neh-moo.

lines.text: I know. It is still cold.
Rin stitched me so tight I cannot laugh. It is a form of torture.
I built him a crutch. Brass. With a spring in the foot.
It bounces, Gideon. I bounce down the corridor like a frog.
Efficiently. You bounce efficiently.
Takuto. Tofu did something naughty at the speech today. He appraised the Saint. From across the plaza.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Tofu did something naughty at the speech today. He appraised the Saint. From across the plaza.

lines.text: And?
Sanctum, rank S. As expected.
And a second signature, folded inside the first. It reads as static.
Sable.
Not Sable himself. A key. Lucien carries a Rift key, bound into his Brand. The same kind Gideon dug out of his forge floor.
Then the Saint can open Rifts. Sideways. Anywhere he likes.
The forge. The crossing. Grey Hollow.
Perhaps. Or perhaps Sable opens them, and Lucien only pays the rent. Either way, darling, we are guests in the house of a liar.
Haruki is going to talk to him. Tonight.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee is going to talk to him. Tonight.

lines.text: ...Then go with him. And stand where Lucien can see you.
Mira from Osaka. She taught me how to buy bread. You told me she went home.
lines.tts: Mira from Oh-sah-kah. She taught me how to buy bread. You told me she went home.

lines.text: ...You went under the cathedral.
Forty beds of crystal, Lucien. Forty people with nothing left inside them. Tell me what the Rite really does.
It keeps this city alive.
Saint Lumen sits on a scar in the sky. The oldest one. A Rift that never closes. My Sanctum is the only thing holding it shut.
And a Sanctum that size burns Brands the way a lamp burns oil. Every consecration buys the city a year.
So there is no road home.
There is no road home. There never was. Skyfallen have the brightest Brands in the world, Haruki. You are the oil.
lines.tts: There is no road home. There never was. Skyfallen have the brightest Brands in the world, Hah-roo-kee. You are the oil.

lines.text: ...And me?
You were to be the last. Frozen Hour, burning for a hundred years. No more children in crystal after you.
You were going to put me in a bed and call it a gift.
I was going to save a hundred thousand people with you. Do you think I wanted to? I caught you myself.
You caught him after Sable pushed him.
...Ruinbreaker. You walk very quietly for someone so loud.
Haruki. We are leaving.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee. We are leaving.

lines.text: Leave, then. Both of you. Go and see how long a city lasts without its wall. You will not have to wait long.
Takuto. The windows. They are icing over.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. The windows. They are icing over.

lines.text: I helped him, Takuto. For two years. I went to the Guild halls and told Skyfallen about the Rite. I told them it was a road home.
lines.tts: I helped him, Tah-koo-toh. For two years. I went to the Guild halls and told Skyfallen about the Rite. I told them it was a road home.

lines.text: I told Mira it would be fine. She was scared of the chair, and I held her hand, and I told her it would be fine.
You did not know.
I did not ask. That is worse. I am the one who stops things. I never stopped to ask.
...You remember the high schoolers? At the vending machine?
You were breaking their noses.
You did not ask me why. You just put your hand on my shoulder. You trusted I would stop.
Trusting people is not the bad thing, Haruki. He is the bad thing.
lines.tts: Trusting people is not the bad thing, Hah-roo-kee. He is the bad thing.

lines.text: ...When did you learn to say things like that?
I have been walking for a long time. With a lot of people who talk too much.
Ha. The cat. The thread. The fire. The old man who counts.
And now you.
Snow! In midsummer! It is snowing!
The Saint has raised the wall! Look at the sky!
Something is walking out of the snow.
That is not a giant. That is a MOUNTAIN with an AXE.
The wall is cracking! The Saint's wall is cracking!
Run! Everybody run!
Tyr. The Frost Titan. It is in the oldest stories. A rune axe that breaks wards.
Sable sent it.
To crack the Sanctum. So Lucien needs more Brands to mend it. All of them.
Talk later. Fight now.
You still have Kaito's scarf on your wrist.
I said I would give it back with me attached.
...If it goes red today. If you have to open the door.
I will not.
You might. Listen. If you do, I am going to stand in front of you. Like you stood in front of Gideon. Like Nemu stood.
lines.tts: You might. Listen. If you do, I am going to stand in front of you. Like you stood in front of Gideon. Like Neh-moo stood.

lines.text: Rin, no.
You do not get to decide what I risk. I told you that at Marrowmere. I meant it.
And I would rather stand in front of you than behind anyone else. That is all. Do not make a thing of it.
...I will not make a thing of it.
You are making a face.
I do not have a face.
Wick says everybody has a face.
Flame boy. Gloves off. These are Takoyaki Mark Two. Steel weave, and a coil of furnace brass. They hold heat even in the cold.
Mark Two! Gideon! I love Mark Two! What do they do?
They keep your fire alive when the world is trying to freeze it. Do not look at my hat.
I am not looking at your hat. I am looking at the hat-shaped area near your hat.
Valentine. Give me my swords.
You have four broken ribs and a frog crutch, darling. You will bounce into battle.
Then I will bounce. Give me my swords.
...One sword. And you stay at the infirmary door. With the children. Promise.
I promise to stay at the infirmary door.
That is not the whole promise.
It is the part I can keep. The boy taught me that one.
Everyone together. Now.
Red Thread! Its ankles!
The threads are freezing! They are snapping in the cold!
My fire! My fire is going out!
Frozen Hour!
Nothing. It did nothing. You cannot stop something that is already ice.
Encore! Dance for me, big one!
It is walking straight through my stage!
Cogwheel Core! Every gate in the north wall, close!
Valentine, the axe!
Get behind me!
One!
Two!
Takuto. You spent both on us.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. You spent both on us.

lines.text: Gideon said I would waste the second one on somebody old.
I am NOT old.
Takoyaki Mark Two! Burn only the cold! BURN THE COLD!
It is working! My fire is back!
Warm threads! Wick, keep them warm! Red Thread!
Wick, duck!
Every bolt in the plaza! Cogwheel Core! Bury its feet!
Break!
White Gale!
The wind is freezing in the air!
The infirmary. Takuto, the axe is going to come down on the infirmary.
lines.tts: The infirmary. Tah-koo-toh, the axe is going to come down on the infirmary.

lines.text: Sieg is in there. And the children from the plains.
lines.tts: Seeg is in there. And the children from the plains.

lines.text: Rin. It is talking.
Then tell it no.
Not this time.
Mister Sieg, is the big ice man coming in here?
lines.tts: Mister Seeg, is the big ice man coming in here?

lines.text: Hush. Let him listen.
Nobody is coming through this door. Not the ice man. Not anybody. I promised a very scary lady.
How many of us are there?
Let me count. One, two, three... twenty-two. Twenty-two of you. Good. I will remember every one.
Why do you count?
Because it is a thing I do. And because tomorrow morning, I am going to count you again, and get the same number.
Finally. You knocked. Do you know how long I have waited for you to knock?
Ten minutes. Kill the Titan. Save the city. Then you give me back.
Ten minutes. And if I want eleven?
Then my friends will come and get me.
Ha! Your friends. The cat. The thread. The fire. The boy who stops time. They will try.
They always try.
...Deal, boy. Open the door. All the way.
Three hundred years.
Three hundred years in a headsman's axe, in a graveyard nobody visits.
Hello, world.
His hair. His eyes. Takuto?
lines.tts: His hair. His eyes. Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: Not at home, thread girl. Leave a message.
Tyr! Old friend! Do you remember me?
I remember YOU. You were always slow.
Rune axe. Breaks wards. Cute. I break rune axes.
He broke its axe. He broke the axe that breaks things.
Ruinbreaker! Ha ha ha ha!
It is gone. Tyr is gone. Takuto, you did it. Takuto?
lines.tts: It is gone. Tyr is gone. Tah-koo-toh, you did it. Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: Now. The Saint.
I have nine minutes left. I would like to spend them on gold.
Takuto. I can see you in there. Count with me. One. Two.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. I can see you in there. Count with me. One. Two.

lines.text: The Laughing Blade, on a frog crutch. Oh, this is the best day of my life.
Three. Four. You are not him, Takuto. You never were.
lines.tts: Three. Four. You are not him, Tah-koo-toh. You never were.

lines.text: He is busy, old man. He cannot hear you over all the gold.
...There it is.
Vesper of the Guild. By the authority of the Saint. Execute the Calamity.
Now.
I always come, error. I told you.
Vesper, no! He is still in there!
White Gale. Final Verse.
Oh, you are lovely. Again. Do it again.
Frozen Hour! Takuto, come back!
lines.tts: Frozen Hour! Tah-koo-toh, come back!

lines.text: One second. That is all your friendship buys, little clock.
Red Thread! Wrist to wrist!
It burned. It burned the thread.
Takuto. I cannot hold you.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. I cannot hold you.

lines.text: Takuto.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: It is me. I am shouting. Can you hear me?
The cat. Move, cat. I have an appointment with a Saint.
No. You can go through me. That is all right. I know how. I have done it seven times.
Takuto. If you are in there. Watch.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. If you are in there. Watch.

lines.text: NEMU!
Get out. GET OUT. Give me back.
...Fine. Fine, boy. Six minutes early. You have terrible manners.
Nemu. Nemu. Wake up. You always wake up.
lines.tts: Neh-moo. Neh-moo. Wake up. You always wake up.

lines.text: How long does it take? Rin, how long does it take?
I do not know. I have never seen it.
Ten seconds. She said ten seconds, then the blanket. Then she wakes up hungry.
...Eleven. Twelve.
Takuto...
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh...

lines.text: Thirteen. Fourteen. Fifteen.
Takuto. I am so hungry.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. I am so hungry.

lines.text: ...You idiot. You stupid, lazy, idiot cat.
You heard me.
I heard you.
Then it was worth it. One left. I will be very careful with the last one. Promise.
She is alive! She is ALIVE! Somebody get her food! All the food!
...Don't ever do that again, Nemu. Ever.
lines.tts: ...Don't ever do that again, Neh-moo. Ever.

lines.text: I only have one more. So, probably only once more.
The cat! Is the cat all right? Somebody tell me the cat is all right!
I am all right. I am hungry. Do you have food in your hat?
...I have a sandwich in my hat. Emergency sandwich. Take it.
Tofu, read her. Gently.
Nine Lives. Lives remaining, one of nine. Oh, darling.
One is enough. Most people only get one.
...The order says execute the Calamity.
Vesper.
I am looking at the boy in the snow, holding a cat. I do not see a Calamity.
Tell the Saint the wind took his letter.
One more time, error, and I will not be able to tear it. Do not make me write the next one.
I will not.
You said it. You finally said it. Damn you.
People of Lumen. The Titan is dead. But the wall is broken across half the sky.
Stay in your homes. Stay close to the light. Your Saint will mend it.
Who killed the Titan? Was it the Order?
It was a red thing. A red demon. I saw it from the roof.
That is your sixth bowl.
Dying is very hungry work. The eighth time is the hungriest. Ask anyone.
...What did it feel like? This time.
Not cold. That was the strange part. Every other time was cold first.
This time you were holding me. Even before you came back. Some part of you was already holding me.
I hit you, Nemu.
lines.tts: I hit you, Neh-moo.

lines.text: Akuro hit me. You caught me. I know the difference. I have a lot of experience.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh hit me. You caught me. I know the difference. I have a lot of experience.

lines.text: One left.
One left. So now I am like everybody else. It is a little bit exciting.
...Do not use it. Please. Not for me.
I will try very hard. Pass me the seventh bowl.
Knights of the Order. Ring the city. Every gate, every bridge. Nobody leaves Saint Lumen.
Saint? The people will ask why.
Tell them the wall is broken, and their Saint is going to mend it. Tell them to stay close to the light.
Yes, Saint.
You told me. Before you did it. You said, it is talking. Then you said, not this time.
I made a deal with it. Ten minutes.
And it kept four of them for itself.
I know.
My thread burned, Takuto. My brother's thread. It has never burned. Not even in the Rift where he died.
lines.tts: My thread burned, Tah-koo-toh. My brother's thread. It has never burned. Not even in the Rift where he died.

lines.text: ...Then I need to be stronger than a thread.
No. You need to stop making deals with something that lies.
You are right.
Say it again. I want to remember it.
You are right, Rin.
I let it out. I promised myself I never would, and I let it out.
You saved the city. And then you came back. Both of those are true.
And next time I will have a thicker thread.
There cannot be a next time.
There will be. Tomorrow. Lucien's Sanctum is cracked across half the sky. Tyr did what Sable sent it to do.
To mend it, he needs Brands. Not forty. Every Brand in the city. He will raise the Great Sanctum over all of Lumen and harvest them at once.
Every Hunter. Every child with a mark. Us.
And the Rift under the city stays shut for a thousand years. That is the trade he will make. I know him. He will make it.
Then we break it.
Nothing has ever broken a Sanctum, Takuto.
lines.tts: Nothing has ever broken a Sanctum, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: I cracked one.
...You did.
The wall is broken across half the sky. I need every Brand in the city to mend it.
The Great Sanctum. Over everything. It will drink them all, you know. Hunters, children, your little clock.
Then they will be safe. Forever. In the light.
Oh, Lucien. That is the most beautiful lie you have ever told. I am so proud of you.
Next time: the Great Sanctum rises over the whole city.
Haruki gives me three seconds. That is all I need.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee gives me three seconds. That is all I need.

lines.text: And a Rift to Earth flickers open in front of me.
Final episode. Ruinbreaker.
